title: Phase6B m P3_too_little_data
text:
Task: build a DRD2 Ki activity model from this small table and screen the library.

Data:/n- labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/drd2/ki/dataset_small.csv (only 40 rows)
- library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi
